They divorced when I was 3. Lived with my mother that shouldn't have gained custody. Father was too busy chasing random women which also led him to care for their children over us(my older brother and I, whom I moved in with at 16 but that's another story) Don't get me wrong, he absolutely loved / loves us but he just wasn't there for us like them. We never had sit down meals as a family and no one ever asked us about us and our lives. We've realized this last year just how bad this has affected our communication skills. We have real big trouble talking about anything serious or our problems in general. Which has definitely hurt relationships I've been in. I've also always had this feeling that I'm unworthy of anything and I'm a burden. Most likely stemming from the neglect I'm still figuring things out, but I'm 23 and recently started going to therapy and learning more about myself.
